source_snapshot.test_name_items: BMC to collect all the log files via Redfish & Web UI
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Enter BMC Web UI -> Click "System Logs" -> Click "Collect System Logs".

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. All logs (System Event logs, Security logs, SEL logs, OEM logs, POST logs) will be downloaded as a package.
2. Total duration won't over 10 minutes.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" sel list 2>&1; echo ---; curl -s -k -u "$BMC_USER:$BMC_PASS" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -X GET https://$BMC_IP/redfish/v1/Managers/bmc/LogServices | jq
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: collect System Event + Security + SEL + OEM + POST logs via the commands shown and return them concatenated. No RISK.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES substitutes a SEL text listing plus LogServices inventory for the required WebUI `Collect System Logs` operation. It never starts or monitors a collection job, downloads one package, validates an archive/manifest, proves five named log families or measures the ten-minute bound; it also weakens TLS, exposes credentials and calls sensitive bulk collection no-risk.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED correctly restores the asynchronous collection/download workflow, five-family package validation and duration criterion. This review additionally defines the timing start/stop boundary, snapshot-versus-live-entry reconciliation, archive traversal/symlink safeguards, per-family freshness/readability checks and a no-retry rule for a timed-out job.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 866/2291 accepts the concatenated command because it produces output and never evaluates WebUI job semantics, package integrity, included components, ten-minute timing, sensitive-data custody or BMC load.
historical_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: No sequence-1029 draft exists in the invalidated 1,000-record run.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-33 preserves the blanket pre-clear and records its evidence defect; ED-34 treats job/package/format inputs as readiness; ED-35 forbids replacing the collection function with read-only inventory; ED-38 requires trusted access, controlled artifact handling, one approved job, no automatic retry and engineer-owned verdict.

original_test_intent: Use the BMC System Logs collection function to create and download one package containing System Event, Security, SEL, OEM and POST logs, prove every required component is readable and corresponds to the collection snapshot, and complete the defined collection interval within ten minutes.
original_method: The Master instructs a WebUI `Collect System Logs` action and package download, after a blanket clear. The Review layer preserves that workflow and timing requirement but retains representative source logs, records per-service boundaries, starts one approved collection, follows its supported job state to a single package, validates the archive safely and then verifies the live services were not cleared or mutated.
manual_activity: The owner supplies the collection/job/package contract, authorizes one potentially resource-intensive BMC collection and approves custody of the sensitive archive. Automation may start and observe that single approved job, download and validate the package and compare log boundaries; an operator handles any vendor cancel/recovery action and the final verdict.
required_inputs: Exact BMC endpoint/certificate, firmware/WebUI build, role and System Logs > Collect System Logs control or supported API/action
Job creation/status schema, terminal states, progress, result URI lifetime, safe cancellation, timeout and behavior when another collection is active
Package format/manifest and filename mapping for System Event, Security, SEL, OEM and POST logs, including nested archives, encoding, schema and empty-family semantics
Authoritative ten-minute measurement boundary—UI click/request acceptance to job completion or completed download—and synchronized monotonic/wall-clock evidence
Pre-collection IDs/counts/sequences/timestamps for each family, snapshot cutoff/concurrent-event rules and expected post-collection nonmutation
Isolated free-space-limited evidence location, maximum package size, safe parser, checksum, malware/archive traversal protections, redaction/retention and BMC/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Do not clear any log service before collection. The blanket pre-clear would make five-family completeness vacuous and destroy the records needed to compare package contents with the source services.

Do not represent `sel list` plus a LogServices collection as the package. The functional result must be one artifact produced by the supported Collect System Logs workflow with an observable job/result identity.
Use trusted endpoint identity and protected authentication; do not use `curl -k`, expose passwords in arguments or place an unredacted archive in a shared/default download directory.

Treat the downloaded package as untrusted sensitive input. Enforce size/depth limits, reject absolute paths, `..` traversal, unsafe links/devices and unexpected executable content; parse in isolation before opening individual logs.

Run one approved collection only, monitor BMC responsiveness and existing collection jobs and never retry automatically after timeout/unknown status. A second job can hide first-failure timing and further load the controller.

Stop on target mismatch, insufficient storage, unknown manifest, corrupted/oversized archive, missing family, job error/stall, management degradation, credential leakage or evidence mutation; preserve job/artifact evidence and use only the vendor-approved cancel/recovery path.
agent_execution_scope: Before approval, validate target/job semantics, evidence storage and safe parser; capture complete source-family metadata and representative record boundaries without deleting logs.

After explicit approval, start exactly one supported collection, record request/job IDs and timestamps, poll only at the documented rate and download the one result to isolated storage when the job reaches its defined completed state.

Hash and safely inventory the artifact, validate its manifest/container, map and parse all five required families and reconcile stable IDs/counts/time coverage with the pre-job snapshot while accounting for concurrent events.
Measure the approved timing interval, reread source services and BMC health to prove nonmutation, report partial/timeout/error state without retry and never issue DUT PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the exact collection control/API, job terminal/timeout/cancel behavior, ten-minute timing boundary and target maintenance window.
Approve the package manifest/family mapping, empty-log acceptance, snapshot/concurrency rules, evidence custody/redaction and safe parser limits.
Review job, package, duration, source-preservation and BMC-health evidence as separate checkpoints and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Useful only as limited baseline discovery after security correction. It does not invoke the required function, monitor a job, download a package, validate contents or measure duration; `sel list` is one family and the LogServices collection contains metadata, not the requested files.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the firmware-supported Collect System Logs WebUI/API action exactly once, follow the returned/documented job to completion, download the resulting artifact, then safely validate the manifest and each required family against preserved source boundaries while recording the approved end-to-end time interval.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The WebUI route/control, five named log families, single downloaded package, under-ten-minute Criteria, generic pre-clear text, absent Script and 10/0-minute estimates remain preserved; no read-only inventory substitution is accepted.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Perform a single instrumented collection transaction with pre-source boundaries, documented asynchronous job tracking, isolated artifact download, safe manifest/five-family verification, timing measurement and post-source/BMC health checks.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The designated lab BMC whose collection control, job model, package layout and resource limits are documented for the installed firmware.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC firmware/WebUI, Redfish/OEM action schema, package/manifest version, browser/client and archive parser versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor system-log collection API/job/package specification and Project sensitive-log retention/redaction policy.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Retains the WebUI package behavior and ten-minute limit while protecting existing evidence, verifying asynchronous result identity and safely inspecting the artifact instead of trusting a download or concatenated output.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Listing services proves availability only; downloading without manifest parsing does not prove five-family completeness; family presence without record reconciliation does not prove snapshot fidelity; job completion without artifact receipt is not end-to-end success.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Collection/job contract, package/family map, timing boundary, source snapshot rules, secure storage/parser limits, approval and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Bulk collection can burden BMC CPU/storage, include secrets/security events, produce large hostile/corrupt archives or race with live log writes; asynchronous timeout can leave a running orphan job.

project_override_considerations: A Project may use an approved Redfish/OEM collection action instead of the WebUI button only if it records the original UI method, actual API/tool and version, reason, engineer approval, proof that the identical five-family package/job semantics are covered and any UI-specific coverage left unverified. Separate per-service GETs are not equivalent to the consolidated package function.
expected_evidence: Target BMC/firmware/WebUI, trusted certificate, role and exact collection control/action/job schema identity
Pre-job System Event/Security/SEL/OEM/POST service IDs, counts/sequences/timestamps and representative record identifiers with no-clear proof
Single collection request/UI action, immutable job ID/status/progress/error/result URI and synchronized start/completion/download timestamps
Downloaded artifact origin/name/size/checksum plus safe extraction inventory and manifest/container/parser validation with traversal/link/size protections
Per-family file presence, readability/schema/freshness and stable-ID/count/time reconciliation against the collection boundary, including concurrent/empty-family treatment
Approved ten-minute calculation, post-job source nonmutation, BMC health/resource state, custody/redaction record, no-retry/recovery notes and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Before-Test blanket clear removes the representative records that must demonstrate all five log families were faithfully packaged; with no stimulus to repopulate each family, the package-content criterion could be satisfied only superficially by empty placeholders. The collection purpose remains clear, so the setup is preserved but excluded in the Review layer.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The consolidated collection action, required five-family artifact and ten-minute criterion are explicit. Missing job/package schemas, timing boundary and secure storage are resolvable Project/vendor execution inputs, so this is PACKAGE rather than permanent BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Changes YES to PACKAGE and rejects concatenated CLI listings as a substitute for the WebUI-generated five-family timed package.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its single-job/package model while adding precise timing, snapshot reconciliation, safe archive parsing, controller-load stop conditions and no automatic retry.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Replaces command-output acceptance with end-to-end job/result/artifact verification and sensitive-evidence governance.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: No prior invalid draft exists for this sequence.

review_improvement: Prevents service metadata or empty files from masquerading as a complete support bundle, prevents hostile/sensitive archive mishandling and preserves the first timed job outcome instead of hiding it with an automatic retry.
independent_technical_reasoning: A collection function is an asynchronous artifact-production pipeline: source services, job, result URI, downloaded bytes and parsed components must form one traceable transaction. The five required family names make content verification mandatory, while the ten-minute condition requires an agreed end boundary. Clearing first destroys the comparison baseline, and separate GET output never exercises package assembly, so neither shortcut can satisfy the Master intent.
